rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for agreement between people or a generally pleasing harmony of elements.

example.english: There is good harmony among the people on this team.
example.jyutping: ni1 deoi6 jan4 soeng1 cyu5 dak1 hou2 wo4 haai4

rows.note: Use this for interpersonal accord based on shared understanding or tacit cooperation.

example.english: We work together with great harmony.
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 zou6 je5 hou2 jau5 mak6 kai3

rows.note: Use this for the balanced matching of colours, design features, or other non-musical elements.

example.english: The colours in this furniture set are in pleasing harmony.
example.traditional: 呢套家俬嘅顏色好協調。
example.jyutping: ni1 tou3 gaa1 si1 ge3 ngaan4 sik1 hou2 hip3 tiu4

rows.note: Use this specifically for musical or vocal harmony between parts.

example.english: The harmony sounds beautiful when the two guitars play together.
example.traditional: 兩把結他一齊彈，和音好靚。
example.jyutping: loeng5 baa2 git3 taa1 jat1 cai4 taan4 wo4 jam1 hou2 leng3
